name: fold-companion
description: Companion pane across the iPhone Duo fold; sheet on every other display.
docs: Builds with the iOS 27.1 SDK (Xcode 27.1 or later): the fold comes from `GeometryProxy.reservedRegions(kind: .division, options: .includeInactive)`, behind `#available(iOS 27.1, *)`. On iOS 26.0 to 27.0 the companion always opens in a sheet. Apply it inside the `NavigationStack`, on the screen's root content, so the measured container spans the display; a container offset from the fold leaves a pane under 300 points and falls back to the sheet. For two panes that always show, use the `fold-arrangement` recipe (native `ArrangementView`).
accessibility: Companion keeps its open state across poses; only the person closes it.
Off the fold: system sheet, VoiceOver dismiss; on the fold: second pane in reading order.
